findings.text: the baseline leg (written_ns > baseline_ns) is the production path — the resume door records manifest_baseline_mtime_ns at resumption.py:1428 and writes it at :1472 before calling _record_resume_supersedes_head at :1474 — but no test sets a baseline alongside a superseded head, so every case in tests/test_a_resume_that_delivers_at_the_same_head_is_reviewed.py exercises only the resumed_ns fallback at :163; a regression in the baseline comparison would leave the suite green.

_resumed_attempt_delivered re-implements the manifest-generation comparison the repository already owns as runs._manifest_freshness (reckon/crew/runs.py:149, fresh = manifest.stat().st_mtime_ns > int(baseline)) instead of calling it; the recovery-review path is a second copy of a freshness rule that four other modules already read through the owner.
